Assistant tool exposure and approvals vary by account/client/workspace; installation smoke tests are mandatory.
GDPR roles, national requirements and MDR/IVDR intended-purpose qualification depend on actual operations and feature claims.
Price hypotheses and product-market demand remain unvalidated.
